# Reverend Ez

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** theology student and minister  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P14](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0014), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>
- **Titles:** Reverend  <sub>[v3 c24 P14](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0014), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)</sub>; Mr. Hale  <sub>[v3 c24 P21](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0021), [v3 c27 P28](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0028)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Ez  <sub>[v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Ezra is an extremely unattractive young man with a large, gangly frame and ridiculous, elongated legs. He has flaxen, limp, unkempt hair, green eyes, a large mouth, an impassioned gaze, and a scholarly forehead.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)_

## Personality

Ezra possesses an unquestionable beauty of soul and nature, demonstrating a deep, serious, gentle, and faithful character. He has a delightful voice, laughs and jokes readily, and expresses himself with a quiet, respectful tone. Known for his ability to make decisions quickly, he also holds lofty spiritual standards.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c24 P20](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0020), [v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025)_

- unattractive appearance  <sub>[v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010)</sub>

## Goals

- to fulfill the labor assigned to him by God as a clergyman  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>
- to take over and serve at a small mission church in the slums on Tanner Street  <sub>[v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>

## History

Ezra studied theology at St. Columbia after graduating from Wexcombe. During one summer, he took charge of the Prospect Point Mission Church, where he stayed at a local boardinghouse. There, he formed a swift friendship with Cressida Lindsay, accompanying her on fishing, boating, and moonlight walking outings. Although he initially resisted entering the ministry, he embraced it as his divine calling and delivered a splendid sermon at the local village church that deeply moved Cressy. The two fell in love and became engaged, planning to marry a year from the following June, after which he would take charge of a small mission church in the slum district on Tanner Street.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c24 P16](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0016), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)_
